<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_missingness = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Get indicator columns (excluding city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate

# Create missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': [missing_counts[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'missing_rate': [missing_rates[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'kept': [missing_rates[col] <= 0.30 for col in indicator_cols]
})

# Write missingness report (RFC 4180 compliant)
missingness_report.to_csv(output_missingness, index=False, quoting=pd.compatQUOTE_MINIMAL)

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Create selected matrix with kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Write selected matrix (RFC 4180 compliant)
selected_df.to_csv(output_selected, index=False, quoting=pd.compatQUOTE_MINIMAL)

print(f"Processed {len(df)} rows")
print(f"Found {len(indicator_cols)} indicator columns")
print(f"Kept {len(kept_indicators)} indicators (missing_rate <= 0.30)")
print(f"Kept indicators: {kept_indicators}")
